svg.title: How the system works out a price
svg.text: Each Procedure on a Booking is priced on its own,
Chosen by the office at booking setup. The
anaesthetist can change it until the List is authorised.
No contract (RVG), standard RVG pricing, is always
Billed to: set by the Contract (step 4).
Sets the base units. Not needed where the line
fixes the price; a line may fill it in for you.
From start and finish: 1 per 15 min for the first
2 h, then 1 per 10 min, part interval rounded up.
Picked one by one by the anaesthetist, each
with a short note, because insurers ask for it.
Each anaesthetist sets their own dollar value
per unit; never a shared price list.
Picks the Contract version in force on that day.
Choosing the Contract, its line and the RVG code
fills them in. Then they are the Procedure's own.
on any Contract, at any time
No reason needed · every change audited and
flagged at review · the last change stands.
St George's does not let the anaesthetist change
it: they see the 10% applied, read-only.
Changing the Contract or its line resets these to
the new Contract's; anything entered is cleared.
One question decides it: does the Procedure
A fixed price from the Contract line, a prepaid
amount, or a price entered by someone permitted.
BTM units are kept for reference if recorded.
Rate: the Contract's rate where it sets one,
otherwise the anaesthetist's own unit value.
Discount: held as a fraction (10% is 0.1) and
shown as its own line on the invoice.
A price of $0 gives a no-charge invoice.
No price can be worked out: it is not
submitted; it can be sent on to the office.
Contract not valid on the procedure date: the
original values are used and a warning flagged.
The Contract decides who gets the invoice.
Patient: the payer named on the Booking
Prefilled from the patient; can be changed to a
parent, guardian or other person who pays.
Snapshot when the List is authorised
Later changes to the RVG or a Contract never
change an invoice that has been issued.
One H3 anaesthetic: 6 base + 7 time + 1 modifier = 14 units, anaesthetist's own value $40
Price $3,565 from the line, BTM for reference
Dr B. Smith's own price list
Values reset to the new Contract's
Price set to $0 by the anaesthetist
Flow: Contract and RVG code fill the values → anyone permitted may change them → price → invoice and snapshot·Still open: multi-procedure rule, prepaid price changes, locked modifiers
